title: Allele-specific CRISPR perturbation of the imprinted Dlk1–Dio3 domain reveals regulation of BMP–NOTCH–VEGF signaling in embryonic organogenesis
reason: Biological discovery paper with multiple conditions (HOMO, MK, PK, WT) and multiple organs (liver, heart, placenta) from E14.5 mouse embryos, suitable for multi-sample integration and batch correction benchmarking. ScRNA-seq data deposited in GEO (GSE274171, GSE255900) and custom analysis code on GitHub.
methods_summary: Generated four mouse models via CRISPR/Cas9 insertion of a transcription termination cassette in the Dlk1-Dio3 domain. Performed scRNA-seq on E14.5 liver, heart, and placenta for each genotype. Integrated transcriptomic analyses to study allele-specific effects and signaling pathway dysregulation.
